fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of monthly Gross Sales or $1,500/month, whichever is greater. Franchise Option Program: royalty is 9% of Gross Sales for initial term. Conversion Franchise Program: royalty reduced to 2% of Gross Sales or $1,500/month (whichever is greater) for first 24 months. Brand Fund Fee is 2% of monthly Gross Sales with no stated minimum. Technology Fee is $650/month (may be waived for second/contiguous territory). Additional recurring fees include: Field Service Software $279/month/license + $300/month for integrated marketing features; Digital Marketing Services $375/month + optional $49/month add-on; Digital Lead Generation 20% of ad spend or $100/month whichever is greater; Financial Management Software $25/month/license; Agentic Customer Assistance $0.75–$2.50/conversation (optional); Email Marketing $169/month for up to 5,000 emails (optional); Postcard Marketing $199/month for up to 120 postcards + $1.65/additional (optional); Phone & Messaging $34.99/month/user + $0.012 cents/text (optional). Convention Fee up to $1,500/year. Transfer Fee 25% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Renewal Fee 20% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Interest on overdue payments at 12% per annum or maximum permitted by law. Most fees subject to annual increase cap of 10% with 30 days notice.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Royalty: 5% of your monthly Gross Sales or $1,500 per month, whichever is greater. Due monthly on the 15th day of each month. See Note 2 and Note 3.
Brand Fund Fee: 2% of your monthly Gross Sales. Due monthly on the 15th day of each month. See Note 2 and Note 4.
Convention Fee: Up to $1,500 depending upon costs. Due at registration. See Note 5 and Note 11.
Transfer Fee: 25% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee. On or before the date of transfer.
Renewal Fee: 20% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. At time you sign a renewal franchise agreement.
Technology Fee: $650 per month. Due on the 15th day of each month. See Note 6 and Note 11.
Field Service Software: $279 per month, per license, and $300 per month for integrated marketing features. As invoiced.
Digital Marketing Services: $375 per month, plus $49 per month for additional optional tools. Due on the 15th day of each month.
Digital Lead Generation Services: 20% of total advertising spend or $100, whichever is greater. Due on the 15th day of each month.
Financial Management Software: $25 per month, per license.
Initial Training Fee: $500 per attendee per day.
Additional Training: Currently $500 per attendee per day.
Interest: 12% per annum or maximum rate permitted by applicable law.
Agentic Customer Assistance Services: $0.75 to $2.50 per conversation or call. Due monthly on the 15th day of the month.
Email Marketing Services: $169/mo. for up to 5,000 emails. Due monthly on the 15th day of the month.
Postcard Marketing Services: $199/mo. for up to 120 postcards, and $1.65 per additional postcard. Due monthly on the 15th day of the month.
Phone and Messaging Services: $34.99 per month per user, plus $0.012 cents per text message.
